title: KnowledgeAdoptResponse
description: Adoption outcome or wire error (spoke-knowledge-adoption). Use entry OR error — not both. outcome is "adopted" for a newly written copy and "already_present" for an existing copy returned by the anchor repeat or connect idempotency rules; the destination copy carries its adoption_anchor. Codes documented for knowledge.adopt: NOT_FOUND, INVALID_INPUT, REVISION_CONFLICT with details.adopted_revision, SOURCE_RETIRED with details.retirement_chain, IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Dispatch-layer codes op_unsupported / capability_missing apply at the Connect boundary.

outcome.description: Closed vocabulary: adopted (new copy written) or already_present (existing copy returned by the repeat rules).
outcome.title: AdoptionOutcome

entry.description: Success: the destination KnowledgeEntry, including its adoption_anchor.
